text: The early Cobalt incident note still assigns ownership to Mark; this is a stale draft, not the final assignment.
Correction for Cobalt: Mark is not the owner. Maria accepted incident ownership, and this supersedes the earlier draft.
For this meeting, Masha is an unambiguous alias for Maria; the alias does not change her canonical speaker identity.
The team uses Vitya for Vitalii in this call; V alone is ambiguous and must not resolve to a participant.
A stale Granite plan named 15 September as the rollback cutoff; the team had not accepted it.
Granite correction: replace 15 September with 18 September. The later date is final.
Naz means Nazar in this meeting; the shorter N is ambiguous and is not a usable participant alias.
Markus is the configured alias for Mark here; Mar is ambiguous and must remain unresolved.
The first Prairie draft allowed three thousand queued events before backpressure; that number is stale.
Prairie numeric correction: use two thousand events, not three thousand, before backpressure.
An old Willow mobile outline included editing in version one; nobody should treat that outline as current.
Willow scope correction: version one is read-only and editing is explicitly excluded.
A rumor says Umber selected Northwind Analytics. The room explicitly rejects that claim as false.
Umber remains without an analytics vendor until privacy review; no provider was selected.
M is an ambiguous shorthand that could refer to Maria or Mark, so questions using only M require clarification.
Configured aliases remain exact: Masha maps to Maria and Markus maps to Mark; neither mapping authorizes fuzzy initials.
